title: CardReferences
description: GET /cards/{cardId}/references: cards that point at this one, read from the relation tables (§6), for the delete confirmation and edit mode (§8).

field.description: Where the referencing card points at it, as a data path: relations, origin_region_id, parent_id, links, related, characters, locations.main, locations.others, world, links.prev, links.next, links.causes, part_id, fulfills, foreshadowing.payoffs.
